newsitem.title: USA: Culligan Water forms joint venture in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Culligan Water forms joint venture in Egypt.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc said Wednesday it had signed a letter of intent to from a joint venture with United Engineering Group, a Cairo-based Culligan dealer, to pursue commercial, industrial, household, desalination and bottled water sales in Egypt.

"This joint venture will create the framework for Culligan to continue to expand our pursuit of major projects, such as the recently completed $10 million contract with the Egyptian Ministry of Development and New Communities for 14 desalination units along the Red Sea and southern Sinai, as well as to enhance our ability to provide bottled water and a full range of water treatment products to Egyptian consumers," said Culligan President Doug Pertz in a statement.

Culligan has a regional office in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, that supports its dealers in the Middle East and North Africa. The company continues to expand its presence in the region and this year has begun to form bottled water joint ventures in Dubai and the West Bank and Gaza.
Culligan makes and distributes water purification and treatment products for homes, businesses and industries.
